About Centric Software: 
 
 Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.
  
 Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.
  
  
 
 OUR VISION FOR THIS ROLE: 
 In your new role as  Site Reliability Engineer , you will support us right in the heart of our SaaS, as an integral member of the Site Reliability Engineering team. You will be responsible for the Shoppingfeed product, working in close relations with our software developers and infrastructure engineers, but also with our security and QA colleagues.
 
 YOUR CURRENT TASKS WITH THE OPPORTUNITY TO GROW – WHAT WILL YOUR LIFE AT CENTRIC SOFTWARE LOOK LIKE? 
 
 In your everyday work you have a diverse range of tasks with lots of space for development: 
 Diagnose and resolve application-level reliability and performances issues across the pull request path (nginx -> php-fpm -> application -> database/cache)
 Tune and scale the web-serving layer under production load — php-fpm pool sizing and process management, nginx timeouts/buffering/upstream keepalive, capacity planning.
 Solid experience configuring and troubleshooting  nginx  as a reverse proxy / web server (timeouts, buffering, upstream keepalive, diagnosing 502/504s).
 Proven experience diagnosing and resolving  performance and scaling problems under load  (latency, worker/pool saturation, capacity planning).
 Develop, maintain, and support our own Docker-based workloads 
 Own the product deployment and upgrade process end to end 
 Support and troubleshoot running customer-facing services 
 Work 50% of your time with our product teams, ensuring much-needed improvements get defined, explained, worked on and rolled out 
 Continuously helping to improve both our product and the infrastructure underneath, by taking the responsibility together with your team 
 Define reliability metrics and ensure they are kept by all the systems you oversee 
 Be part of our On-Call and On-Duty rotations 
 
 YOUR PROFILE – WHAT DO YOU NEED TO FIT IN? 
 Minimum qualifications 
 2+ years proven experience with Linux CLI 
 2+ years proven experience with Docker or other container technology 
 Strong hands-on experience with PHP applications and their runtime (php-fpm process management), able to read and debug application code
 5+ years proven experience with GIT  
 You have good knowledge over a multitude of technologies (from Linux Kernel and Load Balancing to PHP, AWS S3, from container orchestration to MySQL/MariaDB and Elasticsearch) 
 B2 English 
  
Preferred qualifications 
 3+ years proven experience with configuration management tools (Ansible; Saltstack; Puppet; Chef etc) 
 1+ years proven experience with Kubernetes 
 3+ years proven experience managing clustered Linux servers 
 2+ years experience working in a team, on large GIT projects 
 3+ years proven experience with  CI/CD tools (ideally Github Actions or similar tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins)
 with a monitoring tool (ideally Datadog or prometheus/grafana or kibana/elasticsearch)
 2+ years proven experience managing Elasticsearch clusters 
 2+ years proven experience managing MySQL / MariaDB 
 Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues [
 3+ proven experience with at least one cloud provider (ideally AWS)
 3+ proven experience with IaC tools (ideally Terraform)
 proven experience with RabbitMQ is a plus
 
 YOUR PERSONALITY – BE A PART OF OUR RELENTLESS PIONEER STRATEGY: 
 Communication: you like to share your knowledge with your colleagues and to document your work 
 Curiosity: 
You want to find out the root cause of problems and fix them permanently 
You enjoy introducing innovations and implementing improvements 
You are interested in exciting current trends and technological developments in the cloud environment like Docker and Docker Swarm, Ansible, Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment and AWS services 
 Customer first: we are here to support our customers and do all in our power to help them 
 Initiative and Ownership: you make it, you run it, you break it, you fix it 
 
 SOME GOOD REASONS TO JOIN OUR TEAM: 
 We offer you a versatile job with high personal responsibility and global challenging tasks
 You can work in a professional, international working environment with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths
 We live a co-operative and respectful corporate culture with fun at work and room for own ideas
 You have the chance to learn, develop and grow with support of our whole international team
 A collegial and appreciative corporate culture with fun at the task and room for own ideas
 Flexible work schedules 
 Remote or Office based
 Competitive salary
 Corporate healthcare insurance plan (after probation period)
 Access to Company Mobility Program
 Entitled to extra paid leave days package, starting with 25 days yearly total and growing with seniority in the Company
 We provide possibility of therapy sessions, as part of the Employee Assistance Program
 A modernly equipped and pet-friendly workplace
 
  
  
 Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.
